notes: The reviewed collector stores normalized USDT-perpetual liquidation rows from Bybit, OKX and Binance into SQLite.
Upstream explicitly documents Bybit as its highest-integrity liquidation stream while Binance and OKX are structurally sampled or throttled.
Any future Crypto Autopilot use must preserve exchange provenance and per-venue coverage quality instead of treating the aggregate as uniformly complete.
The reviewed collector normalizes side semantics to position-side meaning rather than raw order-side meaning.
Binance order side is explicitly inverted before storage, while Bybit and OKX use different source conventions.
A future adapter must preserve a named internal convention such as LONG_LIQUIDATED / SHORT_LIQUIDATED and must not infer trade direction from a generic BUY/SELL label.
Cascade and liquidation-leader tools derive aggregates from the local liquidation tape.
Because Binance and OKX are structurally undercounted, cross-venue cascade totals can inherit venue-specific observation bias.
Severity labels and dominant-side summaries therefore remain descriptive challenger features until independently validated.
AgentFeed exposes funding, open interest and long/short positioning that overlap Prefetched Derivatives Context V0.1.
The reviewed positioning implementation uses Bybit public REST for SOL/BTC and represents long/short shares as percentages rather than fractions.
These surfaces should not replace the already-created native derivatives contract or canonical provider authority.
Upstream publishes composite labels such as squeeze score, crowding reads and other interpreted market signals.
Those outputs embed upstream thresholds and semantics that are not validated under Crypto Autopilot governance.
They must not directly select a strategy, change Router thresholds, generate candidates or authorize a trade.
Paid MCP and HTTP tools settle USDC through x402 and the upstream client/plugin documentation supports automatic wallet payment.
The server code records payer-wallet and settlement transaction metadata after payment.
Crypto Autopilot's current zero-cost and secret-isolation boundaries do not authorize a funded wallet, private key, x402 settlement or paid call.
The reviewed MCP surface includes some free tools, but using the hosted service would still add a remote runtime dependency.
No hosted AgentFeed endpoint call is authorized by this evaluation, including free endpoints.

overall_decision.recommended_next_step: Build an isolated no-network liquidation-context quality contract using synthetic/non-holdout fixtures. Require explicit venue, coverage_quality, side_semantics, observed_at and available_at metadata; reject generic BUY/SELL trade-direction interpretation, paid-runtime provenance without a captured receipt, and any strategy/trading authority.
